chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Abbas ibn Musa, from Yunus, from Amr ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'The young slave girl, the man buys her.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'If she has become needless from her parents, then there is no problem.'

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / it is permissible

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for buying a young slave girl according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the legal status of a young female slave by introducing the concept of *istighna* (independence), indicating that her maturity or self-sufficiency serves as the criterion for specific rulings. This reflects the Shia juristic understanding that legal capacity in slavery is not solely determined by age but by the functional ability to be independent of parental guardianship. The ruling underscores the nuanced approach of the Imams in adapting legal statuses to the social and economic realities of the time.
